settings.ggYZeJATo1-_text: Give a Gift That Brings Everyone Together
settings.gginLjfrm9r_text:
Some gifts are meant to be opened and admired, while others give you an opportunity to spend time together. Memobrick offers both.

 

A favorite family photo becomes a custom brick mosaic that everyone can help build, turning gift-giving into a shared experience.

 

Parents, children, grandparents, and siblings can work on the mosaic together, placing each brick piece by piece while talking, laughing, and remembering the moment captured in the photo. By the time it's finished, you've created more than a personalized decoration—you've created another family memory.

settings.ggQZYkU5vNh_text: Thoughtful Thanksgiving Gifts That Bring Families Closer Together

settings.ggMcB_L83eV_text: Make Memobrick Part of Your Thanksgiving Tradition
settings.ggMx1pSfg6f_variantSelectionRequiredMess: Please select a variant to add product to cart
settings.ggS8jVNN-ej_text:
The perfect Thanksgiving photo doesn't have to be professionally taken. Look for an image that captures a genuine family moment and brings back a happy memory.

Consider a photo from:

  • A previous Thanksgiving celebration
  • A family reunion
  • A holiday vacation
  • A birthday or milestone
  • A funny family moment
  • A favorite childhood memory
  • A recent family portrait

For the best results, choose a clear photo with good lighting and visible faces. Larger Memobrick sizes are especially useful for group photos because they can preserve more details.
settings.ggaQQdlpQJl_text:
One of the best things about a personalized photo gift is that it can be meaningful for almost anyone.

 

For Parents: Turn a cherished family photo into a keepsake that celebrates the family they've built.

 

For Grandparents: Choose a photo with their children and grandchildren to create something they'll proudly display.

 

For Siblings: Use a funny childhood photo, family vacation, or unforgettable moment you shared together.

 

For Children: Let them help build a favorite family photo and turn gift-giving into a fun activity.

 

For Your Partner: Celebrate a special memory you've created together with a personalized keepsake.

 

For the Whole Family: Choose a group photo that captures everyone together and make the building experience part of your Thanksgiving tradition.
settings.ggbM3amxFUd_text:
Thanksgiving is the perfect occasion to celebrate the memories that brought your family together. A favorite family portrait, a memorable holiday gathering, or a photo from a special trip can become a personalized Memobrick that keeps those moments close.

 

The finished mosaic can become a meaningful piece of home décor, displayed somewhere the whole family can enjoy. Every time someone sees it, they'll be reminded of the people, laughter, and moments that make their family special.
settings.ggcoRiuOidl_text:
Every family has its own Thanksgiving traditions, from preparing the same recipes each year to watching movies after dinner or taking a family photo around the table. Adding a Memobrick to those traditions can create something new for everyone to look forward to.

 

Imagine taking a family photo each Thanksgiving and eventually turning one of those favorite memories into a brick mosaic. Over time, each photo can represent a different year, different memories, and different stages of your family's story. What begins as a single keepsake could become part of a tradition that grows with your family.

 

Thanksgiving is a reminder to appreciate what we sometimes take for granted—the people sitting beside us, the memories we've created, and the time we have together. That's why the most thoughtful gifts don't necessarily need to be expensive or elaborate.

A personalized Memobrick combines a meaningful photograph with an interactive experience, giving families something they can enjoy creating together and continue appreciating long after Thanksgiving has passed.
settings.ggq5B0GgOK6_text:
Thanksgiving reminds us that the greatest things in life aren't things at all—they're the people we share our lives with and the memories we create together. A personalized Memobrick turns those memories into something your family can build, display, and treasure for years to come.

This Thanksgiving, give your family more than a gift. Give them an experience, a keepsake, and another memory to add to the story you're creating together.
